projects.title: wanote-cli — Personal Project
projects.description: A lightweight, zero-dependency, cross-platform CLI tool for plain-text notes. Built entirely with Node.js built-ins to provide a fast, distraction-free terminal note-taking workflow with multi-line editing, intelligent search suggestions, and configurable storage.

projects.title: Forkplay — Personal Project
projects.description: A personal project built to strengthen my skills — a next-gen cloud game launcher made with Next.js, TypeScript, and Hono API. Built with NeonDB PostgreSQL, Cloudflare edge services, and integrated Xendit payment gateway, designed to sell online or share on GitHub.

projects.title: QrWise Clinic — Full-Stack Developer (Contract)
projects.description: Worked on a contract basis for QrWise Clinic, applying full-stack skills to build an inventory POS and booking system with integrated marketing tools. Used back-end architecture, mobile development, and web development skills to streamline clinic operations and patient scheduling.
projects.imageAlt: QrWise Clinic — inventory POS and booking system built with full-stack developer skills

projects.title: Gunit — Personal Project
projects.description: A personal project showcasing mobile development skills — a minimalist offline inventory POS app built to support local businesses. Built with Expo and React Native for reliable day-to-day sales tracking without depending on a constant internet connection.
projects.imageAlt: Gunit — offline inventory POS mobile app built with Expo and React Native

projects.title: Everyshelf — Backend Developer
projects.description: Contributed to the development of Everyshelf, an inventory management system & stock transfer management, during my internship. Architected scalable backend services using Hono and Supabase.

projects.title: BogoBallers — Capstone Full Stack Project
projects.description: An end-to-end sports league management system consisting of 3 repositories: a centralized Python (Quart) back-end API server with role-based access control (RBAC), a React.js admin web dashboard for match scheduling and league data management, and a Flutter mobile app for players to track tournament schedules, rosters, and live game updates.
projects.imageAlt: BogoBallers — 3-repository full-stack system: web dashboard, mobile app, and Python backend
